| Part | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `rm` | Remove files |
| `-r` | Recursively delete directories |
| `-f` | Force deletion (no prompts) |
| `/` | Starting from the **root directory** (everything) |

* 🔥 **Completely unrecoverable** without a backup
